errors.text_span: Испания (тъмносин цвят), Франция (оранжев), Китай/континентален/ (сив), Италия (жълт), Турция (светлосин), САЩ (зелен) и Аржентина (най-тъмносин)
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly maps colors to countries. The image shows Spain in blue, France in grey, China in orange, Italy in yellow, Turkey in light green, USA in green, and Argentina in dark blue.
The description does not mention that the values for all countries remain stable throughout the period.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the period 2013–2022.
The description does not mention that the highest values are for Spain, around 950 thousand hectares, and the lowest values are for Argentina, around 200 thousand hectares.
The description does not mention the grouping of bars to compare countries for each year.
